name: space
title: Disk Space
description: See what fills your disk as a zoomable map of boxes sized by space, with the biggest files and folders listed and cleanup suggestions like caches and old build folders. Everything deleted goes to the Trash after a confirm.
author: pal

settings.label: Sizes
settings.description: What the boxes and rows measure: the blocks a file takes on disk (what deleting it frees; sparse and compressed files are small), or its apparent length.

settings.label: Colour boxes by
settings.description: The kind of file (folder, image, video, code, archive, ...), or the place among the siblings with the nested boxes in their parent's hue (the DaisyDisk ring). `c` in the map flips it.

settings.label: Cross into other volumes
settings.text: Count folders on other file systems (mounted disks, images) under the root
settings.description: Off, a scan stays on the root's volume, so a scan of Macintosh HD does not walk every mounted disk. macOS firmlinks (/Users, /Applications on the Data volume) are always crossed.

settings.label: Largest lists
settings.description: How many rows Largest Files and Largest Folders show.

settings.label: Stale after
settings.description: Cleanup Suggestions count a node_modules or target folder, and a download, as stale past this age.

store.tagline: See what fills your disk, and clean it up
features: A zoomable map of any folder or volume: `enter` zooms in, `backspace` out, the arrows move around
Fast scans that draw as they run, and reopen instantly next time
The largest files and folders, with Quick Look, reveal and copy path
Cleanup suggestions: caches, stale `node_modules` and `target` folders, Xcode's DerivedData, old downloads
Mark several boxes with `m` and move them to the Trash together, after one confirm
permissions: Full Disk Access, for ~/Library/Mail and the like (unreadable folders are counted and named)

screenshots.caption: A home folder as a map: every folder a box sized by what it holds and coloured by kind, the list of the biggest beside it
Zoomed into a project, its build output and node_modules marked: one keystroke sends both to the Trash
The largest files anywhere under the root, each with its folder, kind and size; filter to videos or disk images
Cleanup suggestions: caches, package stores, the Trash, old downloads and stale build folders, each with what it frees and what to know

actions.title: Zoom in / Open
actions.description: The focused folder becomes the board; a file opens.

actions.title: Focus
actions.description: The arrows move between boxes by position, Tab by size.

actions.title: Mark for the trash
actions.description: Toggles the focused box; the marked total shows in the header.

actions.title: Move to Trash
actions.description: The focused box, or every marked one, after a confirm.

actions.title: Quick Look, Open, Reveal, Copy path, Info
Rescan
actions.description: This folder again (the root: everything). While scanning: stop.

space.title: Disk Space
space.description: Where to look: your home folder, every mounted volume with its free space, the folders scanned before with their age, and a folder typed in the bar. Enter opens the map.

keys.title: Open the map (scans first when there is none)

map.title: Disk Map
map.description: The treemap: the folder's children as boxes, area by size, their own children faintly inside; zoom in and out, mark and trash.

keys.title: Zoom into the focused folder; open a file
Focus the box in that direction (also down, left, right, and hjkl)
Mark or unmark for the trash
Move to Trash: the focused box, or every marked one (asks first)
Info: kind, sizes, count, modified, owner
Rescan this folder; stop a running scan

largest.title: Largest Files
largest.description: The biggest files under the last scanned root (or the root a link names), kind as a tag; a filter by kind.

keys.title: Move to Trash (asks; marked rows together)

folders.title: Largest Folders
folders.description: The biggest folders under the last scanned root, with their file counts.

cleanup.title: Cleanup Suggestions
cleanup.description: What is usually safe to clear, with its size: user and package caches, Xcode's DerivedData, node_modules and target folders untouched for a month, downloads older than a month, the Trash. Every action asks first and goes to the Trash.

keys.title: Move to Trash (asks); Empty Trash on the Trash row

scan.description: Open the map of a folder, scanning it first when there is no scan

root.description: The folder; ~ is expanded. The home folder without it.

rescan.description: Scan again even when a scan is saved

largest.description: Open the largest files under a folder

root.description: The folder; ~ is expanded. The last scanned root without it.
